inlines.v: OLYM'PEAN, adjective Pertaining to Olympus; or to Olympis, a town in Greece. Olympic games, or Olympics, solemn games among the ancient Greeks, dedicated to Olympian Jupiter, and celebrated once in four years at Olympia. [See Olympiad.]
